scope: Sweep callback allocation failures through the legacy TABLESTYLE DXF writer at the oldest admitted revision and the current writer revision.

source.profile: One legacy TABLESTYLE with three row styles, six ordered borders per row, and one emitted TEXTSTYLE dependency.

checks: Every measured callback allocation failure is reached and refuses the write
The existing destination sentinel is unchanged after each refusal
The caller TABLESTYLE remains unchanged after each refusal
Same-codec retry reproduces the calibrated clean bytes
Fresh typed readback validates the TABLESTYLE identity, owner, name, row count, row heights, and border vector

limitations: Generated transaction evidence only; no producer interoperability or native TABLESTYLE semantics are established.
The R24 rich-cell TABLESTYLE profile remains covered by its existing AC1027 whole-operation control; this receipt does not expand that profile.
